newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan June inflation 1.8 percent - Casas.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan June inflation 1.8 percent - Casas.

text.p: Venezuelan inflation in June decelerated to 1.8 percent from 3.1 percent in May, Central Bank president Antonio Casas Gonzalez said.
In June last year, inflation reached 7.1 percent.
Speaking at a Central Bank lunch for journalists, Casas added that accumulated inflation over the first six months of the year now stood at 14.6 percent, compared with 62.3 percent last year.
June's 1.8 percent inflation rate was well below market estimates of around 2.6 percent, but Casas did not immediately give any explanation for the good result.
The Central Bank was due to release June's figure later Tuesday.
Casas has previously said that if Venezuelan January-June inflation came in at under 15 percent, the country was well set to hit its 30 percent year-end target.
